stories.title: 11 Ohio Medicaid providers indicted in alleged fraud schemes, including double billing and charging for dead clients
stories.summary: Ohio Attorney General Andy Wilson announced indictments for 11 Medicaid providers accused of fraud, with alleged improper billings exceeding $115,000.

stories.title: City of Cleveland names Brendan McNamara as new fire chief
stories.summary: McNamara, a Cleveland native and St. Ignatius graduate, was appointed by Mayor Justin Bibb as the city's next fire chief after nearly 30 years with the department.

stories.title: Leon Bibb remembers the JFK assassination, a moment that changed America
stories.summary: Leon Bibb remembers the assassination of President John F. Kennedy on Nov. 22, 1963, a moment that continues to impact him and American 63 years later.

stories.title: Ohio crime lab identifies dangerous synthetic opioid, raising concerns about what could come next
stories.summary: Scientists at Ohio's BCI crime lab discovered cyclorphine in evidence from an overdose investigation. They've since identified the drug in more than 50 items.

stories.title: Vintage Greyhound buses find new purpose preserving story of the Great Migration
stories.summary: An architect's mission to restore two historic buses brings a powerful chapter in American history to Cleveland's former Greyhound station.

stories.title: Cleveland International Film Festival leaving Playhouse Square, moving to Cedar Lee, Capitol theaters in 2027
stories.summary: CIFF is returning to its original home at the Cedar Lee Theatre, while adding the Capitol Theatre as a venue for its 51st edition in April 2027.

stories.title: Ohio bill would make violent offender database accessible online
stories.summary: Proposed legislation would allow Ohioans to search the state's Violent Offender Database online and expand registration requirements for certain offenders.

stories.title: Breaking the cycle: Northeast Ohio father confronts childhood trauma to build a better future for his children
stories.summary: After battling addiction and spending time in prison, Patrick Vorreiter found hope through The City Mission's Crossroads program.

stories.title: Perry Local Schools identifies cause of cyber incident that canceled classes districtwide
stories.summary: A cyber incident forced the Perry Local School District to close all buildings Monday. The district says there are no signs of personal data being released.

stories.title: Salvation Army Greater Cleveland needs 10,000 toys for annual Christmas campaign after fire destroys thousands: How you can help
stories.summary: Fans attending designated Cleveland Charge and Monsters games can donate new, unwrapped toys valued between $25 and $30.

stories.title: Ohio Senate passes bill banning DEI in public schools
stories.summary: Senate Bill 113 now goes to the Ohio House for consideration.

stories.title: Cleveland Christmas Connection returns to I-X Center this weekend: Here’s what to expect
stories.summary: In addition to all the shopping, Hallmark Channel star Tyler Hynes will be making a special appearance at 1 p.m. on Friday, Nov. 20.
